scientific_stage: Final prospective M2 validation in a Step-0-calibrated dependable-service regime
purpose: Create one new public composition condition G2, calibrate only its global admissibility-region battery using independent white-box calibration data under a predeclared rule, freeze those regions, then compare the already-frozen M0/M1/M2 methods blindly against a fresh independent G2 white-box evaluation set.

evidence_roles.G1: prospective stress test with floor-degenerate WB survival
evidence_roles.G2: prospective final M2 validation after Step-0 AR calibration

G2_public_condition.scientific_change: Use a modest symmetric provider-branch propagation delay shift relative to G0, with no provider-specific assignment and no workload change.
G2_public_condition.reason: G2 should test transfer under a realistic network perturbation without the provider-specific severe asymmetry of G1. The scientific novelty of G2 is the predeclared Step-0 calibration of A_G, not an extreme topology stress.

workload.horizon_grid: unchanged frozen public I1 horizon support

G2_base_boundary_algebra.base_region_source: Forward-compose the already-frozen public provider A_i(rho) boundaries at the same rho through the G2 deterministic graph algebra.

hidden_whitebox_model.selection_provenance: Phase-1 confirmation frozen_after_selection = D330000000_d0.150 matched latency/cost/mixed SLA-native battery

step0_calibration.role: Experimental-design calibration only. It may select A_G2(rho) but may not alter any prediction method.

diagnostic_horizon_window.reason: Avoid startup/low-decision artifacts and calibrate the sustained dependable-service regime.

selection_feasibility_gate_per_rho.interpretation: Reject both floor and ceiling regimes while keeping the WB curve in a high-survival dependable-service range with visible temporal structure.

selection_rule_per_rho.step_1: Enumerate the full frozen (s_L,s_C) candidate grid and retain only candidates satisfying every feasibility gate.
selection_rule_per_rho.step_2: Among feasible candidates choose the one with minimum expansion distance d = sqrt((s_L-1)^2 + (s_C-1)^2).
step_3_tie_breakers_in_order: smallest absolute difference between mean diagnostic sigma and 0.95
smallest absolute difference between sigma(H=240) and 0.95

nesting_check_after_confirmation.failure_action: G2 calibration fails and no prediction/evaluation stage is run.

step0_calibration.failure_policy: If any rho has no feasible selection candidate, any selected candidate fails confirmation, or nesting fails, stop. Do not alter this contract or retune the grid/targets after observing calibration. A new separately named G2b contract would be required.

must_materialize: Step-0 selection white-box ledger and hash
Step-0 confirmation white-box ledger and hash
calibration manifest with all input/output hashes

evaluation.surface: all 5 frozen rho values x all frozen horizons including H=0
evaluation.Jaccard_D_A: N/A because the selected G2 A_G battery is a frozen common query input for M0, M1, M2 and WB

prospective_success_criteria.primary: M2 whole-surface MAE < M1 whole-surface MAE
prospective_success_criteria.confirmatory_1: M2 whole-surface RMSE < M1 whole-surface RMSE
prospective_success_criteria.confirmatory_2: M2 MAE < M1 MAE in at least 3 of 5 rho slices
prospective_success_criteria.absolute_accuracy_diagnostic: Report M0, M1 and M2 absolute errors. Do not define M2 success by beating M0 because the scientific M2 mechanism claim is relative to M1 inverse-collapse.
prospective_success_criteria.chapter_close_rule: After one valid G2 final evaluation, close M2 regardless of outcome. No G2-driven M2 repair is permitted.

next_gate: Implement only the G2 public adapter and Step-0 calibration runner. Validate the frozen grid/rule, generate selection seeds 32000..32099 and confirmation seeds 32100..32199, and freeze A_G2 only if all five rho regions pass the predeclared gates and nesting check. Do not run M0/M1/M2 G2 predictions before the calibration freeze.
